collector.boundary: pullFee transfers only collector-owned token under collector owner; syncReserve/syncReserves only update recorded reserves; no arbitrary surrendered-LP executor was found on this bound surface.

earlierPhysicalLp.rejectionAsserts: Actual holder NotOwner before and after real local feeTo change and one-year advance, unchanged LP balance and totalSupply; actual parent enablement then LP intake InvalidRoute, unchanged LP balance/supply.

weightedException.boundary: Actual local oracle owner set current feeTo; pre-role holder NotOwner, post-role actual LP redemption yielded DTF. Migration does not grant itself source authority.

disposition: E-P permanent protocol custody under the authenticated existing immutable caller surface; conditional W-P conversion is a separate source-specific exception.
limits: No public source role change, original eligibility dataset, general future-market impossibility or new liquidation policy is asserted.
